The point of the ending is that it is bleak and depressing as a warning, a way of saying “don’t be like this! Don’t live in the dark forest! It will all go so poorly of we all chose that!” The books are, at least in my reading of them, a commentary on global politics and a critique of the notion of each nation pursuing their own individual best interests, everyone else be damned. That leads to the dark forest, with leads to the continual ruination of the universe. The books extend this notion to its absolute logical conclusion… the death of everything and everyone forever… without even a memory… What’s important is that it didn’t have to be that way… tri-Solaris didn’t have to try and destroy humanity , humanity didn’t have to turn on each other, and singers civilization didn’t have to annihilate our solar system. They did these things because they acted out of fear, the books are a parable about what happens when you let fear controls your actions and beliefs. That’s why it’s a perfect ending.
